src: source-color object crops s, each paired with its nearest singleton marker m
dst: contiguous output sprite slots d along the marker-dominant axis
match_cond: rank(s by m position on the chosen axis) == rank(d)
transform: crop each s to its bbox, recolor s.mask with m.color, and keep bbox background as background
multi_step: choose vertical packing when marker row span exceeds column span; otherwise choose horizontal packing
grid_shape: common crop size multiplied by number of source objects along the chosen packing axis
